scenarios.editor.outlineOnlyNote: This scenario has a shape the step editor cannot draw (a second fork or a step nothing leads to). Its steps are listed in running order; you can edit each step's settings, not how they connect.
scenarios.editor.issue.missingStart: This scenario has no Start node, so it cannot run.
scenarios.editor.issue.multipleStart: There is more than one Start node: only the first starts the run. Another Start runs as an ordinary step, and only if an edge leads into it.
scenarios.editor.issue.edgeIntoStart: An edge leads back into Start. It is followed, but the run goes on along Start's first branch only; the parallel branches start only when the run begins.
scenarios.editor.issue.edgeOutOfEnd: An edge leaves an End node; it is never followed.
scenarios.editor.issue.extraOutgoing: Step {{n}} ({{title}}) has several next steps, but only Start runs branches in parallel: at run time only the first one runs.
scenarios.editor.issue.unpickableHandle: Step {{n}} ({{title}}) has an edge it never takes: its handle is none of the cases or options the step can pick, so the edge is never followed.
scenarios.editor.issue.danglingEdge: An edge points at a step that does not exist; that branch ends there.
scenarios.editor.issue.unreachable: Step {{n}} ({{title}}) is not reached from Start, so it never runs.
scenarios.templateBrowser.readOnlyNote: Read-only preview: Use template makes a copy you can edit.
scenarios.templateBrowser.selectStepHint: Pick a step to see its settings.
scenarios.editor.issue.noCallHeld: Step {{n}} ({{title}}) needs a CSMS call its branch took over (a CSMS Call Trigger with behavior “replace” earlier in the same branch), but on some path there is none: the run fails there.
scenarios.editor.issue.callAlreadyAnswer: Step {{n}} ({{title}}) answers a CSMS call that its branch has already answered on some path: the run fails there.
scenarios.editor.issue.callLeftOpen: Step {{n}} ({{title}}) takes over a CSMS call that its branch can leave unanswered; the station answers it InternalError only when the run ends. Add a Call Response (kind “none” to stay silent on purpose).
